'''Peter DiBiasio''' is a United Kingdom Star Wars CCG player. Alex Tennet's [[DecipherCon 2000]] trip report records that he went undefeated and won Day 1 Swiss of the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="tennet">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-13-deciphercon-2000-juz-beer-and-cardsd1338/ deciphercon-2000-juz-beer-and-cards], Alex "Greedo" Tennet, Decktech (13 October 2000)</ref>
